en.abdullah-al-shahin: (11) Ali bin al-Husayn narrated from Muhammad bin Yahya al-Attar from Muhammad bin Hassaan ar-Razi from Muhammad bin Ali al-Kufi from Ali bin al-Husayn from ibn Miskan from Malik bin A’yun al-Juhani that Imam Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said: “
Every banner that is raised before the appearance of al-Qa’im will be of an oppressive arrogant.”
